requirements.title: Straight key input
requirements.description: The radio shall key the transmitter within 5 ms of contact closure on a straight key connected to the key jack.
requirements.rationale: SI-018 core requirement; 5 ms keeps element timing imperceptible at 50 WPM (ADR-001).
requirements.verification_note: HostUnit debounce timeline; emulator scenario with GPIO stimulus; bench with dummy load.

requirements.title: Iambic paddle input
requirements.description: The radio shall form Morse elements from iambic paddles with a built-in keyer at any speed from 5 WPM to 50 WPM.
requirements.rationale: SI-018 core requirement; the speed range 5 to 50 WPM is the owner's accepted range (SI-033).

requirements.title: Transmit power
requirements.description: The transmitter shall deliver 5 W plus or minus 1 dB into a 50 ohm load from 144.0 MHz to 148.0 MHz.

requirements.title: Debug console
requirements.description: The firmware shall expose a serial console at 115200 (TBR) baud on the USB port.
requirements.rationale: SI-010 asks for host tests and emulation before power-on; the console carries their logs and the self-test banner of the Need. TBR: the baud rate is an estimate until the rustos console driver fixes it.

tbr.plan: Confirm baud rate against the rustos console driver at PDR.

requirements.title: Battery endurance
requirements.description: The radio shall operate for 8 (TBR) hours at a 1:9 transmit-to-receive ratio on one charge of its cells.
requirements.rationale: SI-034 battery-life target. TBR: the 8 h value is the owner's target pending the power budget; an Active L1 requirement may carry an open TBR until PDR (charter section 7).
requirements.verification_note: Bench run on the delivered unit with a timed key-down duty cycle.

tbr.owner: Claude prepares the power budget; Robin decides
tbr.plan: Power budget analysis at PDR fixes the value; the tbr object is removed in the same CR.

requirements.title: RF exposure at the operating position
requirements.description: The radio shall produce a power density of at most 1.0 mW per square centimeter at 20 cm from the antenna at 5 W output.
requirements.rationale: SI-003 and the RF exposure hazard HZ-002; the value is the controlled-environment limit at 146 MHz.
requirements.verification_note: Analysis accepted per RSK-001: no field-strength meter is available; OET Bulletin 65 far-field calculation with the antenna gain from the datasheet.
